decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm's established compact construction equipment range, it fits the company's problem-solving portfolio and service model, so an early withdrawal is unlikely.
This articulated construction dumper is close to the firm's core offer and should benefit from its engineering, sales and aftersales capabilities, making continuation the more likely choice.

Although the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the established offer and serves a narrower niche, it still matches the firm's underground specialization and innovation profile, so it is more likely to be retained than dropped.

A multi-model compact telescopic loader line indicates a stronger strategic commitment and good fit with the firm's existing machinery business, so management would be unlikely to remove it so soon after launch.
